pages.text: The Guild is the place where you begin your journey. When starting a new world, you will be prompted to begin your adventure. Alternatively, you can delay this and later use `$(k:taleofkingdoms.startconquest)` to open the prompt again.$(br2)When this structure spawns, a collection of NPCs will spawn with it. This includes The Guild Master, who you will want to speak to first.

pages.title: Repairing
pages.text: To repair the guild, you may speak to the Guild Master. This requires 64 logs and 3000 coins. All blocks and entities will be respawned if they are missing.$(br2)Note: If the guild is under attack, you must speak to the Guild Master that was summoned with the attack, and this costs only 64 logs.
